name: Paquetes Wavelet
description: Aplica descomposición completa de paquetes wavelet para análisis de energía de sub-banda de grano fino (Coifman & Wickerhauser).
algorithm: Algoritmo de análisis Wavelet Packet Decomposition
mechanism:
Este método applies Wavelet Packet Decomposition (WPD) following Coifman & Wickerhauser (1992) for comprehensive frequency-domain forensic analysis:

1. **Full Wavelet Packet Tree**: Unlike standard DWT (which only decomposes the approximation subband), WPD recursively decomposes both approximation and detail subbands, creating a full binary tree of 2ⁿ subbands at depth n. This provides uniform frequency resolution across the entire spectrum.

2. **Best Basis Selection**: The optimal basis is selected via entropy-based cost function (Shannon entropy, log-energy, or threshold counting) minimization over the packet tree. The best basis structure itself is forensically informative — natural images optimize differently than generado por IA ones.

3. **Subband Energy Distribución**: Energy distribution across all wavelet packet subbands is computed. Natural images follow predictable energy decay patterns related to the 1/f spectral falloff. AI artifacts produce anómalo energy in specific subbands — GAN grid artifacts appear as energy peaks at characteristic spatial frequencies.

4. **Inter - Subband Correlación Análisis**: Cross-correlations between sibling and parent-child subbands capture statistical dependencies inherent in natural images. generado por IA images often exhibit altered inter-subband correlation structures — either excessive independence (failing to replicate natural dependencies) or artificial correlations from generator architectures.

5. **Coeficiente Distribución Profiling**: Wavelet packet coefficient distributions at each node are modeled. Natural image coefficients follow generalized Gaussian distributions with scale-dependent parameters. Deviations from these models — particularly in high-frequency subbands where generadores de IA struggle to reproduce correct statistics — are quantified for forensic scoring.

accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-85% de precisión según la calidad de entrada.
source: Basado en investigación revisada por pares en forense digital y detección de contenido IA.
useCase: Se utiliza como parte del pipeline de análisis multiseñal para detectar contenido generado por IA.
strengths: • Metodología respaldada por investigación\n• Tiempo de cálculo rápido\n• Complementario a otros métodos de detección
limitations: • La precisión varía con la calidad de entrada\n• Mejor utilizado en combinación con otros métodos
